title: dryopteris mascarensis
intro: Dryopteris mascarensis, commonly known as Mascarene shield fern, is a species of fern native to the Mascarene Islands. This plant is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The health benefits of Dryopteris mascarensis include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
